II—SEC. 3(ii)] नयोगट : प्रंु ख आदेि का.आ. 1045(अ), ददनांक 12 ं ावध 2020 के िररए भारत के रािप् , असाधारण, भाग -II, खंड 3, उप-खंड (ii) के तहत प्र काजित ु आ था रर अंजतं संियोगजधत अजधसूवना संख्या का.आ. 3190 (अ) ददनांक 18 जसतंबर 2020 कयोग ु आ । MINISTRY OF COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY (Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade) ORDER New Delhi, the 25th February, 2021 S.O. 902(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-sections (1) and (2) of section 16 read with sub-section (3) of section 25 of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 (11 of 2016), the Central Government, after consulting the Bureau of Indian Standards, is of the opinion that it is necessary so to do in the public interest, hereby makes the following Order further to amend the Safety Glass (Quality Control) Order, 2020, namely:- 1. Short title and commencement.– (1) This Order may be called the Safety Glass (Quality Control) Amendment Order, 2021. (2) It shall come into force on the date of its publication in the Official Gazette. 2. In the Safety Glass (Quality Control) Order, 2020, in paragraph 1, for sub-paragraph (2), the following sub- paragraph shall be substituted, namely:- “(2) It shall come into force with effect from 1st April, 2022.”. [F. No. 11(6)/2017- CI] ANIL AGRAWAL, Jt. Secy. Note : The principal Order was published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- section (ii) vide number S.O.1045(E), dated the 12th March, 2020 and lastly amended vide notification number S.O.3190(E) dated the 18th September,2020.
